beats.shot: extreme close-up on a clear glass of baking powder
beats.does: pours hot water from a plain glass jug onto the baking powder, causing a violent bubbling reaction
beats.says: Pour hot water over it now.

beats.shot: medium shot on Felix and Stella at the counter
beats.does: spoons baking powder from a plain glass jar into an empty clear glass
beats.says: Test Number One checks its activity.
beats.sound: spoon clinking against the glass jar

beats.does: pours hot water from the glass jug over the baking powder
beats.says: Heat activates the acid and base.

beats.shot: close-up on the fizzing clear glass
beats.does: points her finger directly at the rapidly bubbling glass with a shocked, wide-eyed expression

beats.shot: close-up on a second clear glass
beats.does: pours hot water onto old baking powder, which barely bubbles at all
beats.says: Test Number Two uses old baking powder.
beats.sound: flat splash of water with almost no fizz

beats.shot: medium shot on Felix and Stella
beats.does: points directly at the camera while standing confidently next to the dull clear glass
beats.says: It loses reactivity and barely bubbles.

beats.shot: close-up on both clear glasses side by side on the counter
beats.does: slides the fizzing glass next to the flat glass while Stella leans into the frame nodding vigorously
beats.says: Always check before baking. Follow for more.
beats.sound: glass sliding on the quartz counter
